Fed & Policy Watch
  • Latest retrieved SOFR is 3.94% effective Nov 24; NFCI is -0.444 for the week ending Nov 20; MOVE is 97.54 and the 10-year Treasury is 4.85% from Nov 25. These measures are asynchronous, not live. The Chicago Fed calendar puts its next NFCI release on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM ET.
  • The Federal Reserve Board says Thanksgiving-day daily and weekly statistical releases move to Friday, Nov 27; H.4.1 is scheduled at 4:30 PM ET. The December Board calendar lists H.4.1 on Dec 3 at 4:30 PM ET. The next FOMC decision is Dec 9 at 2:00 PM ET, followed by its 2:30 PM press conference; minutes are Dec 30 at 2:00 PM.
  • Energy schedules: EIA petroleum reports use the standard Wednesday 10:30 AM ET time, with no Dec 2 exception listed; natural gas storage uses the standard Thursday 10:30 AM ET time for Dec 3. Thanksgiving-week natural gas reporting was moved to Nov 25 at noon and is elapsed.
  • TreasuryDirect lists competitive bids closing at 11:30 AM ET for 13- and 26-week bills on Nov 30 and a 6-week bill on Dec 1; details are in the calendar.
Omissions and Watch
  • Calendar conflict check: the prior briefing suggested a Dec 2 PCE date. The currently checked BEA schedule and New York Fed December calendar support Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Dec 23 at 8:30 AM ET; no Dec 2 PCE release is confirmed in those sources, so it is omitted. The Nov 25 PCE listing on the November calendar is elapsed and is not repeated.
  • Checked primary calendars: New York Fed November and December Economic Indicators calendars; Federal Reserve Board November and December calendars; BEA schedule; Census 2026 calendar; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI CSV; TreasuryDirect upcoming auctions; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules; U.S. Treasury daily-yield CSV. BLS pages were not requested; BLS dates and ET times are cited from the New York Fed calendar as directed. Calendar selection is not exhaustive. No CME holiday-session hours were independently verified.
  • No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; this was not a full headline-risk review. Material verified items include Treasury bill supply, the H.4.1 release shift, scheduled petroleum and natural-gas reports, and the December employment, inflation and FOMC calendar. No unsupported energy or geopolitical catalyst is asserted.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
SPY's Wednesday close was down 0.29%, while the Friday overnight ES quote is up 1.83% versus its prior completed daily bar. VIX eased to 26.80, but MOVE remains in the moderate band at 97.54. Treat the overnight indication as provisional rather than confirmation. Today's claims and Census release, followed by the Fed balance-sheet report, make event timing relevant; next week adds employment and supply data. Wait for price and rates to confirm after scheduled releases; scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess a neutral/cautious scenario if ES and Treasury yields move decisively together after verified data or bill supply, or if volatility broadens rather than easing. Do not use unsupported price levels or targets. Refresh quotes and verify contract specifications and market liquidity before execution.
